Hi Diego —

Thanks for the heads up. Evan from Gartner reached out asking if a Starlight systems leader could do a short (30-min) analyst briefing next week to discuss how we use Redwood for inference cost controls and latency SLAs. I can speak to ops/ROI and pull a couple of before/after latency percentiles.

Can you confirm:
- Who from Redwood will be on the call?

- Will Gartner want a published case study or just an analyst reference?

I’m looping in Laura from our customer success team to help schedule and handle any collateral/NDAs.

Hi Claire —

Really appreciate you taking this. Quick answers below and a suggested plan so we can keep things low-friction for your legal/comms team: 

1) Redwood attendees: myself (sales lead), Neha Kapoor (product marketing) — both will stick to high-level questions about architecture and outcomes; we’ll avoid anything PHI or patient-level detail.
2) Question topics: cost/throughput before vs after Optimize, latency/SLO experience, rollout timeline, team org (who owns private vs hosted stacks). I’ll send a short 1-page prep doc with the exact bullets.
3) Output: Gartner typically uses the briefing for research; they may ask to add you as an analyst reference. We will not publish a case study or use quotes without explicit written consent from Starlight. If you’re open, we’d love to draft a short case study afterwards and route it through your comms/legal (we’ll provide a one-page draft and a redline-friendly DocuSign for approval).

Proposed next steps:
- Laura, can you share 30–45 minute availability windows Mon–Thu next week (PST)?
- Claire, if you prefer your legal team signs a standard reference consent, I can attach our template.

I’ve attached a short outline (starlight_case_outline_v1.pdf) that we’d use as the basis for a post-briefing case study draft — it contains only anonymized numbers and architectural sketch.

Thanks again — we’ll keep the meeting very focused.

Best,
